ideal_customer.what_we_sell: Outsourced customer support and CX operations: dedicated, trained agents for email, chat and phone, 24/7 coverage, SOPs, QA and AI-assisted workflows, run from Pakistan for brands in the US, UK, Europe and Australia.
ideal_customer.target_roles: Founders, CEOs, COOs, owners, heads or directors of operations, heads of customer experience, customer support or customer service, and dispatch or logistics operations managers who decide how customer inquiries are handled.
ideal_customer.target_companies: Growing logistics companies (couriers, last-mile delivery, freight forwarders, 3PLs), consumer robotics and hardware brands, and DTC e-commerce or Shopify brands, roughly 10 to 500 employees, that handle a steady volume of customer inquiries.
ideal_customer.not_a_fit: Students, job seekers, recruiters, other call centres or BPO and outsourcing agencies, software engineers and other individual contributors with no say over support, government, and very large enterprises with big in-house contact centres.

personas.founder_or_owner: Founder, co-founder, owner, CEO or managing director of a company
personas.operations_leader: Runs operations: COO, VP, director or head of operations, operations manager, dispatch or logistics operations manager
personas.cx_support_leader: Runs customer experience, customer support, customer service or a contact centre
personas.ecommerce_leader: Runs e-commerce, a Shopify store, or retention for a DTC brand
personas.outsourcing_competitor: Works at a BPO, call centre or outsourcing agency that sells a similar service
